performance_case.causal_mechanism: A derivative-demand and constrained-arbitrage state known before a BTC spot DRA entry may identify uncompensated path risk, but only if its semantic identity is distinct from legacy funding logic and from derivative execution or carry harvesting.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may freeze only one source-agnostic semantic label, strict pre-decision eligibility semantics, legacy non-duplication boundary and unchanged spot-DRA participation mapping. It cannot choose or validate a source, endpoint, venue, instrument, maturity, field, formula, normalization, sign, threshold, lookback, cadence or horizon; access any value or outcome; establish prediction, significance, fee-adjusted PnL, drawdown, costs, capacity, source continuity, candidate readiness, OOS value or deployability; install or activate source plumbing; interrupt R2; or authorize Trading.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future separately frozen and matched-capital experiment could improve drawdown only if an independently captured carry state predicts adverse paths without excessive missed winners or concentration; all such effects remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A bounded semantic audit prevents source and parameter choices from being smuggled into a promising prior, blocks legacy funding logic from being relabeled as new alpha and determines whether any further carry research is worth one source-readiness task while R2 continues untouched.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL effect is zero. The only present value is deciding whether one later pre-outcome source and representation audit is causally expressible before values or outcomes are visible.
